title: Bound canonical directory storage against complete payload
body:
PR2569 leaves a numerical directory reserve open, while PR2590 already supplies its serialized field size and corrected setup bill. This contribution proves an explicit component allowance: the exact directory extent `D=1+CH(h+1)J` is below `2^-130 V` for the complete payload `V=CHR`, under the stated large-q, root-depth, body-size and minimal-code premises. A four-bit encoding and the separate `5D` parking term receive explicit bounds too.

The proof retains every delimiter, the LEFT cell, and physical duplicate/empty prefixes. It stops at directory storage: caller lifetimes, total live payload, routing buckets, role markers, count/controller tapes and child/dirty workspace still require their own ledger. No full caller reserve, selected-frontier change, runtime saving or new kappa is claimed. The revision-5 task card records the bounded scope change and family gate.

Validation: registered Python 3.12.7 normal and optimized replays passed eight unchanged-producer cases and 189,338 exact output symbols, 96 large-integer arithmetic checks and 16 semantic/domain controls. A Git-free export passed; three source corruptions and a bool/int receipt mutation were rejected. The large-integer fixtures do not claim primality or huge-q producer execution. Independent AI proof/code review is recorded in the handoff.

Sources: current PR2569 `898ff36fe2cd05f733de6b26c88a4c4741b06237`, by Jose Manuel (jmbarrancoml), and PR2590 `8803e0ced7d5cc8a6db1b11157742f70981f4f42`, by ywz65. Their exact source bytes and attribution are retained. Canonical main refreshed to `1884c509efc004524786e9b7cfcc4aca572316d5`; priority revision 5. The complete overlap snapshot covers 838 open PRs and 1,303 Discussion records; the active first-node caller in Discussion2319 explicitly leaves numerical reserve admission open.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No human/formal-kernel review or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Final parent compatibility check: canonical main advanced to `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`. Guidance, selected record and the sole live scientific input remain unchanged (input Git blob `f05225d21f92cf8cef21b6e12601d5b4d61991f0`); both external source heads above remain current. The frozen scientific baseline is intentionally retained.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-directory-storage-reserve
```
